scope: Recorded finite organizer-image instruction counts for the 64-copy blocks; not a production execution or a proof of collision probabilities.
environment: curvesma-reference-count (gcc Debian 14.2.0-19, valgrind 3.24.0, linux/arm64); -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only -static; one fixed input file per batch size for both builds.
model: delta = 4*B/8 - 4*B/64 - 4, including the four-instruction net entry-tree cost; B=65536 gives -28668 and B=1048576 gives -458748.

checks.dump_check: n=1 (skip) and n=64 (plain and anchor) walk dumps are byte-identical between base8 and n64
checks.trampoline: the 2^60 cap uses tbz to a local trampoline followed by a wide b 2f; the normal path is one instruction
